data.narrative:
Aventra is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by veterans with deep DoD and cyber backgrounds, having raised $3M to date. The peer universe comprises four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparable companies (Stark Defence at $4.0B Series A, UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, NODA AI at $125M Series A), supplemented by a broader set of 10 private defense-tech firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $3M raised proxy, implying $8M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the four comparables yields $700M, reflecting the wide dispersion typical in frontier defense markets ($125M–$4.0B range). The peer approach weights heavily on UFORCE's $1.0B seed valuation, a direct stage peer, though the sample skews toward Series A financings.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $6M to $805M, with a median of $354M. This wide band reflects acute stage and business-model heterogeneity within the peer set. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively; peer-median is sensitive to whether UFORCE's valuation represents market consensus or an outlier. Key uncertainties include Aventra's product-market fit maturity relative to peers, recurring revenue traction, and customer concentration in U.S. defense procurement.
